what: Photos inside photo slots (masks) scattered across the panel each hide 110% outside the slot in a set direction (up·down·sideways·four corners). Once 30% of the panel is visible they slide into place over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), each slot delayed by its order × .13s, sliding only with no fading. A gallery where a collage gathers from all sides around the big title and comes together

options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Photo cell (child) — the cell becomes a mask and its first child slides in
options.data-from: Side to hide on (in the slot) — bottom (default) · top · left · right · tl · tr · bl · br
options.data-i: (On the cell) order number — if absent, the cell order (from 1). If the order differs per width, the caller’s css gives each cell --fx-i instead of data-i (in that case leave it as is)
options.dist: Hide distance (% of cell size), default 110
options.threshold: Share of the panel that must be visible, default .3
